name: Roasted Tomato Risotto
description: Creamy, comforting and lush, this Roasted Tomato Risotto is a perfect late summer/early autumn meal to share with those you love.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup freshly grated romano cheese (or vegan equivilent)

recipeInstructions.text: Start with the tomatoes: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit. In an oven-safe casserole dish, stir together the cherry tomatoes, olive oil and salt. Slide the casserole into the oven and roast for 35-40 minutes stirring once about halfway through.
recipeInstructions.name: Start with the tomatoes: Preheat the oven to...

recipeInstructions.text: Meanwhile, start the risotto. Gather your ingredients. Heat a large Dutch oven or other similar pan over medium heat. Add the olive oil and let warm. Stir in the onions and cook, without disturbing, for about 6-7 minutes until they begin to get translucent. Stir and then cook for an additional 2-3 minutes. They should be softened, but not browned.
recipeInstructions.name: Meanwhile, start the risotto. Gather your ingredients. Heat...

recipeInstructions.text: Add the arborio rice to the pot and stir to combine. Cook for 2 minutes and then stir in the white wine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until it's absorbed into the rice — about 3-5 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the arborio rice to the pot and...

recipeInstructions.text: Add the vegetable stock a little at a time, stirring after each addition and allowing to absorb into the rice before adding more. Continue until all the stock has been added. Taste a grain of the rice at this point. It should be tender. If not, add a bit more liquid (such as stock or water).
recipeInstructions.name: Add the vegetable stock a little at a...

recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the romano cheese and season the risotto with salt and pepper. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
recipeInstructions.name: Stir in the romano cheese and season the...

recipeInstructions.text: Divide the risotto onto plates and top each with 1/4 of the roasted tomatoes (including the liquid!). Sprinkle with fresh basil and serve.
